title: Bearer credentials in authorization headers: must not be flagged
summary: Bearer headers whose value is a variable reference, not a literal. Covers 1 input.
rationale: Bearer tokens have no provider format. The header context and the value's length are the only signals, so they are project policy, stated as such.

expectation.rationale: Independent public control for the bounded credential policy profile.

sources.supports: Cited by the legacy assessment (provider documentation); claim not itemised.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Imported as a draft from the legacy suite "Public policy qualification controls for bounded T3 credentials (#365)" (policy-qualified-credentials); not yet reviewed.
